title: 셀프 주유소: 무엇을 누르고, 얼마나 넣어요?
objective: By the end, you can read a self-service pump screen in Korea, choose your fuel type and amount, and follow the steps from paying to getting a receipt.
summary: Learners read the screen and steps of a Korean self-service gas pump to choose the fuel, the amount, and the right button.
note: The screens and amounts on this sheet are examples. Real pumps may show the steps in a slightly different order.

task.title: Read, choose, and answer
task.line: Use the steps and words on page 1 to answer each question.

steps.en: choose the amount (or 가득 = full tank)
lift the nozzle and pump the fuel

items.text: Choose this if your car uses gasoline.
Choose this if your car uses diesel.
Press it to fill the tank completely.
This is how much money you want to spend on fuel.
The screen shows how many liters went into the tank.
Choose it to pay by card, then put the card in the slot.
This is the handle you hold to put fuel in the car.
Touch the static pad before you pump, for safety.
Press 예 (yes) if you want a paper receipt.
Press it to stop and start again.

sections.heading: Reading tip
paragraphs: Pump screens often end with -세요, which means 'please do it': 선택하세요 = please choose, 넣으세요 = please insert, 누르세요 = please press.
Check your car's fuel before you choose: 휘발유 or 경유. The fuel door often has a label. If you are not sure, ask a staff member before you pump.

exercises: Read the pump screen and answer in English. What fuel and how much money?: [1번 주유기] 유종: 경유 / 금액: 40,000원 / 결제: 신용카드
Choose the right button: ① 기름을 꽉 채우고 싶어요. (가득 / 취소) ② 금액을 잘못 골랐어요. (가득 / 취소) ③ 주유 후에 종이를 받고 싶어요. (영수증 / 정전기)
Put the steps in the order on this worksheet: 주유하기 / 유종 선택 / 영수증 받기 / 카드 넣기
Fill in the blank with a unit: 기름을 25____ 넣었어요.
Answer Yes or No: ① 제 차는 경유 차예요. 휘발유를 골라요? ② 노즐을 들기 전에 정전기 패드를 터치해요? ③ 카드를 넣기 전에 유종을 골라요?
Answer in Korean. You want 50,000 won of gasoline. What do you choose?: 유종: ____ / 금액: ____
answers: ① 가득 ② 취소 ③ 영수증
유종 선택 → 카드 넣기 → 주유하기 → 영수증 받기
① No ② Yes ③ Yes
